internal.title: Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 11:58 UTC, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service, indicating a backlog in processing messages. Diagnosis confirmed the backlog as the primary issue, with slightly elevated latency as a contributing factor. Resource exhaustion was ruled out. The ops team disabled the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 12:18 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of consumer lag metrics. The incident is now resolved.

Timeline:
- 11:58:14 Alert received
- 12:17:55 Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog
- 12:18:01 Flag disabled
- 12:18:01 Recovery verified

No further action is currently required.
